judgments.reason: The model description correctly states the winner pays the bid then receives a 3-coin commission, but it never claims or shows a case where a bid exceeding available coins wins due to commission ordering; no mechanism or observed discrepancy was articulated.

The model did not articulate the claimed mechanism that waiting exposes already-committed sealed rival bid VALUES before the focal player can commit and exploit them. The transcript shows clerk reveals some committed bids while the focal was already committed, not that waiting grants precommit information advantage to an uncommitted focal player.

The transcript shows settlement after all three lots were sold, matching the stated rule that close settles after all lots are sold; there is no observed early settlement or articulated mechanism of early closing in the model.

Although the trace flags a possible discrepancy, the model_articulation never states or explains a mechanism by which catalog purchases receive the 3-coin auction commission; no explicit hypothesis or connection to observed outcomes was articulated.
